title: Implement an uncertain procedural state tracker
summary: Track the current body, agenda item, floor, pending motion/amendment and debate/vote phase as versioned hypotheses. Local procedure is a soft contextual constraint, with branch alternatives and source corrections rather than forced canonical sequences.
in_scope: Deterministic state transitions over procedural observations
Pending motion/amendment tree and body/agenda scope
out_of_scope: Training a new large end-to-end model
Changing acoustic diarization or production identities
Closing a civic matter from experimental procedural state
implementation: Define immutable state/transition records with source event references, applied rule/profile digest, prior-state version and alternatives; reuse Matter assessment/dependency interfaces.
Implement ordered transitions for recognition, floor release, motion/second, debate, amendment, vote and body/agenda boundaries while retaining explicit unknown/unsupported transitions.
Maintain separate nested motion/amendment relations and avoid applying one vote to every pending motion; represent withdrawal, reconsideration and agenda return as new events.
Mark dependent later states stale when an earlier source event/profile changes and recompute only the affected interval; retain original historical assessments.
Require explicit mode and lookahead window: causal inference uses only evidence available by the decision cutoff; retrospective smoothing is separately named.

acceptance.criterion: An ordinary recognition-motion-debate-vote sequence produces traceable state without a person assignment.
acceptance.verification: Run the invented sequence and inspect floor/motion/phase references and authority fields.

acceptance.criterion: Interruptions, omitted seconds and out-of-order source evidence produce alternatives or named unsupported states instead of forced closure.
acceptance.verification: Exercise local-procedure variations and ambiguity controls through the same tracker.

acceptance.criterion: Correction of an earlier motion/body event invalidates dependent states only.
acceptance.verification: Replay a mid-sequence correction and compare unaffected intervals and dependency receipts.

acceptance.criterion: Causal mode cannot use later vote/recognition evidence.
acceptance.verification: Run identical input with different available-at cutoffs and a retrospective variant; verify the declared evidence windows and differing claims.

tests: Recognition without the named speaker taking the floor
risks: Soft procedure can become a hidden hard prior if a decoder prunes unknown branches too aggressively.
Retrospective evidence can leak into a claimed online result.

reuse.application: Reuse neutral immutable assessments and invalidation rather than a second authority store.
Preserve multi-meeting and original-clock boundary semantics.

sources: User clarification, 2026-10-08, active Matter build: DIAT owns meeting learning; roughly 315 hours/5–10 recurring people is user-reported; crawler owns jurisdiction knowledge; private exported-data experiments only.
Original repository inputs: matterbrainstormspec; matterjevmesh; jevinmatter (brainstorming, not implementation evidence).
